claims: Real estate involves buying, selling, or leasing land and buildings.
Real estate is categorized into residential, commercial, industrial, and raw land.
Real estate agents are typically paid a commission by the seller upon closing.
Real estate agents' commission is a percentage of the sale price.
The total commission is often split between the buyer's agent and the seller's agent.
ZipRecruiter notes that while many real estate agents are commission-based, some positions such as certain bank-owned REO agents or corporate roles may offer salaries.
REITs are companies that own income-producing real estate.
Real estate transactions require appraisal, inspection, and securing financing.
Residential real estate includes single-family homes, condos, townhomes.
Commercial real estate includes office buildings, retail spaces, hotels.
Industrial real estate includes warehouses, factories, distribution centers.
Raw land includes undeveloped property, agricultural land.
Special use real estate includes schools, parks, churches.
The MLS is the Multiple Listing Service.
EXp Realty notes that the closing process involves clearing contingencies, transferring titles, and paying agent commissions.
